_comment: Orc Warlord cleave (content pass C6, plan-content-zones12.md §B): the boss's single active aura — multi-effect on the Vanguard precedent, because exactly one aura is active at a time (mobs included): a heavier OrcCleave sweep (3 targets, brute physical) PLUS a lingering bleed dot (physical+bleed, DamageBurst's tag pair) that keeps pressure on whoever rotates out. Sustained healer stress between Frenzy windows is the design point (PO kit pick: Cleave + Frenzy + bleed). Curve-position-1 baseline. All values [PLACEHOLDER]
